entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought a few weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To best help, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's definitely a preference and fit issue. I've used them a couple of times, but they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but they just don't seem to work for my feet.

I'm very sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's certainly not the experience we want you to have. I'm pulling up our policy. I see here that the purchase was made 24 days ago. Is that correct?
Great. Well, the good news is that these cycling shoes fall under our standard 90-day return policy. So, you're well within the window. I can go ahead and authorize a full refund for you.

Okay, a full refund sounds good. Thank you for that. Now, since I do have to go through the trouble of packing these up and I'll still need to buy a different pair, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for my next VeloFit order?

I understand the inconvenience. While our system doesn't allow me to issue a discount code on a return transaction, I can assure you that your refund will be processed promptly once we receive the item. We can email you a prepaid shipping label right now to make the process as easy as possible.
Alright, that's fair. The prepaid label helps. As long as I get the full refund, I'm happy. Please send that over.
Of course. I'm sending that label to the email we have on file for you now. You should see it within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
